name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=ai, descriptor=seek_optimal_position). No address residue. Name accurately reflects behavior: pathfinds to the highest-scoring reachable tile (the 'optimal position' per the painted threat overlay) for the char's movement-cost class and walks one step there. Confirmed by caller fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher, which uses it as the 'scoring/attack failed, move instead' fallback in AI classes 1/3/5/11.
purpose: AI movement fallback: pathfind to the best-scoring reachable tile for the character's movement-cost class and walk one step there, returning whether a move occurred.
logic_summary: Reads src_x/src_y (runtime_char[char_idx][0],[1]) and movement_class (runtime_char[char_idx][0x20], job-based). Overrides: if fd2_check_char_status_immunity!=0 -> class 0x13 (flying/unrestricted); if identity byte 8 == 0x1C -> class 1 (cheap movement). Gets the move-cost table via fd2_get_movement_cost_table_for_job, paints the team threat overlay (fd2_paint_threat_overlay_for_team), runs fd2_pathfind_to_destination into a 4-byte dst_xy scratch, then restores tile-map obfuscation (fd2_obfuscate_battle_tile_map). If pathfind==0xFF -> unreachable, return 0. If dst==src -> already optimal, return 0 (no anim). Else: anim_phase=0, pan cursor, fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile, anim_phase=1, return 1.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array of the acting (enemy) character. Used to compute pChar = base + char_idx*RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE for src coords/movement class, and passed to fd2_check_char_status_immunity, fd2_pan_cursor_to_char, fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile.
params.reason: Generic param_1 name; actual use is the runtime-char array index. src already names it char_idx; rename live Ghidra param to match (Stage 2).

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: AI context / team flag forwarded unchanged to fd2_paint_threat_overlay_for_team (selects which team's threat overlay to paint) and to fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile. Same value the dispatcher passes through to all AI sub-actions.
params.reason: Generic param_2 name; it is the AI context/team flag passed through to threat-overlay paint and walk. src already names it ctx; rename live Ghidra param to match (Stage 2).

returns.semantics: 1 (true) if the character walked to a new tile; 0 (false) if the destination is unreachable (pathfind returned 0xFF) or the character is already at the optimal tile. Derived from the fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile return value at runtime (the decompiled 'did_move = iVar1 != 0' is a Ghidra EAX-tracking artifact, already documented in the plate).
